criterion: Li transform on a synthetic functional-equation/conjugation-symmetric zero quartet
source_scope: Bombieri-Lagarias arbitrary-multiset Li framework; calibration only, not a zeta-zero model
exact_arithmetic: fractions.Fraction recurrence; no floating-point sign decisions
interpretation: A long finite prefix of Li-type positivity can coexist with an explicitly off-critical symmetric quartet.
Therefore finite-prefix Li positivity alone is not a logically sufficient global RH certificate in the arbitrary symmetric-multiset calibration world.

Any Li-based RH route must supply additional zeta-specific structure and a genuinely uniform-in-n mechanism; the calibration says nothing about whether the actual zeta zero set contains an off-critical zero.
